label: FIP-420 passes: Superstate USCC crypto carry fund approved as frxUSD collateral
note: 2024-12-31: Snapshot vote closes unanimously for USCC, a tokenized crypto cash-and-carry fund, as frxUSD collateral and custodian asset with an initial $20M cap (forum: https://gov.frax.finance/t/fip-420-uscc-as-collateral-and-custodian-asset-for-frxusd/3540)

label: FIP-419 passes: frxUSD launches as FRAX upgrade path
note: 2025-01-06: FIP-419 passes; frxUSD and sfrxUSD launch as FRAX upgrade path

label: FIP-426 passes: Centrifuge JTRSY approved as frxUSD custodian asset
note: 2025-02-25: Snapshot vote closes in favor of adding Janus Henderson Anemoy Treasury Fund (JTRSY) as an enshrined frxUSD custodian with an initial $25M cap (forum: https://gov.frax.finance/t/fip-426-jtrsy-as-a-custodian-asset-for-frxusd-launching-centrifuge-on-fraxtal/3605)
